faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist - III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist - III recruitment is 03 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist - III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Optics, Interferometry, Holography, and Optical Imaging, along with specific experience in Laser Doppler Velocimetry and high-speed cameras.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist - III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 78,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 30%.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist - III role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Scientist - III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Scientist - III position announced by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.answer: The official website for research and development at IIT Delhi is http://ird.iitd.ac.in.
